public_sources.title: Safe testing
public_sources.relevance: Conditional e-variables may be chosen using past information and multiplied under optional continuation while preserving type-I error when each next factor is conditionally e-valid.

public_sources.title: Online control of the familywise error rate
public_sources.relevance: Online alpha-spending controls lifetime familywise error across an a priori unbounded hypothesis stream; resetting local levels is not lifetime control.

public_sources.title: Sequential (Quickest) Change Detection: Classical Results and New Directions
public_sources.relevance: Change detection is intrinsically a false-alarm versus detection-delay problem; a monitor reacts after a change and is not a prospective no-drift guarantee.

public_sources.title: Reproducibility - vLLM
public_sources.relevance: Current official documentation says reproducibility is not guaranteed by default and, when enabled, is scoped to the same hardware and vLLM version.

public_sources.title: Batch Invariance - vLLM
public_sources.relevance: Current beta deterministic serving path; batch invariance makes output independent of batch size/order but intentionally trades performance for reproducibility and has explicit hardware/model scope.

public_sources.title: LLM-42: Enabling Determinism in LLM Inference with Verified Speculation
public_sources.relevance: Primary systems example of a fast nondeterministic decode path whose tokens are verified under a deterministic schedule before commitment, with rollback on mismatch.

public_sources.title: CoRun: Padding is Simple and Efficient for Deterministic LLM Inference
public_sources.relevance: Recent preprint showing deterministic inference need not equal the slowest batch-invariant baseline; tested systems report 15-324% throughput gains over batch-invariant approaches and large latency reductions, but scope is system/model specific.

main_result.title: A statistical fingerprint certificate should be a risk-limited lease. A prospective drift budget can be added to lifetime validity, but reactive monitoring cannot supply that budget; verify-before-reveal can eliminate the drift term if equivalence verification is itself sound.

lifetime_lease_theorem.statement: Let B_cert be the event that any bad fingerprint is statistically certified, B_drift the event that a certified fingerprint exits its frozen mismatch-validity domain during an active lease before evidence is revealed under that invalid state, and B_eval a false improvement commit conditional on all used fingerprints remaining valid. If P(B_cert)<=A_cert, P(B_drift)<=D_lease, and P(B_eval | no bad certification and no drift)<=A_eval, then P(any false commit)<=A_cert+D_lease+A_eval. No independence is required for this union bound.
lifetime_lease_theorem.multi_lease_accounting: For lease j choose a predictable drift allocation d_j with pathwise sum_j d_j<=D_lease. Do not reset d_j after expiry or recertification. This is a real-event risk budget, not a monitor false-alarm budget.

prospective_hazard_bound.general_conditional_form: If request r in lease j has conditional probability of first validity-breaking drift at most h_{j,r}, given the full past and no earlier drift, then P(drift during that lease)<=1-prod_r(1-h_{j,r})<=sum_r h_{j,r}. A safe lease may terminate before this cumulative prospective bound exceeds d_j.
prospective_hazard_bound.constant_hazard_form: For constant conditional hazard upper bound h and drift allocation d, L_max=floor(log(1-d)/log(1-h)); for small h,d, L_max is approximately d/h.
prospective_hazard_bound.critical_boundary: If no nontrivial prospective hazard bound is defensible, worst-case D_lease=1 because validity can fail immediately after certification. A degradation monitor does not repair this: it can only detect after observing post-change data.

economic_break_even.symbols: K=certification cost in a common cost unit; b=net benefit per leased evaluation versus canonical inference after duplicate-compute and monitoring costs; L_risk=maximum lease length allowed by d,h.
economic_break_even.condition: A statistical lease can beat canonical inference only if b>0 and L_risk*b>K. Combining with constant hazard gives approximately h < d*b/K for small h,d.

optimistic_numeric_stress.assumption: One calibration pair costs one canonical-evaluation unit and hedging saves the full one unit per leased evaluation; this is intentionally optimistic.

economic_break_even.interpretation: Using the previous worker-local admission medians K=2276/3700/5679, even the optimistic b=1 case needs hazard below roughly 2.20e-6/1.35e-6/8.83e-7 per leased evaluation to amortize before a 0.5% drift budget is exhausted. Smaller net savings tighten this line proportionally.

verify_before_reveal_firewall.statement: Instead of releasing fastest stochastic output under a statistical lease, freeze a canonical attempt identity and withhold statistical reveal until a deterministic/canonical verifier establishes equivalence. If verifier false-accept opportunities have predictable budgets v_t with lifetime sum<=V_verify, then fast-path contamination contributes at most V_verify; no stationarity or drift-hazard assumption for mismatch prevalence is needed. With exact deterministic equivalence inside a verified contract, V_verify can be treated as zero only inside that contract's documented scope.
verify_before_reveal_firewall.why_it_matters: This converts a prospective environment-stability assumption into a per-output verification obligation. Drift can then increase rollback/latency or unresolved rate without silently changing statistical evidence.
verify_before_reveal_firewall.systems_evidence: LLM-42 is a direct systems analogue: non-deterministic fast-path tokens are verified under fixed-shape deterministic execution before commit and rolled back on mismatch. vLLM batch invariance and CoRun are deterministic-by-construction alternatives with explicit scope/performance tradeoffs.

path_selection_gate: If an exact deterministic/verified path covers the frozen model/runtime/hardware/config fingerprint, prefer it for decision-critical evaluation evidence; benchmark its actual latency/throughput in-scope.

If no deterministic verifier exists and no prospective drift bound can be defended, use canonical single-attempt evidence; reactive monitoring alone cannot justify stochastic first-completion hedging.

If a prospective drift bound exists, allocate non-resetting d_j, compute L_risk, and permit a statistical lease only when its risk-limited horizon is long enough to amortize calibration plus monitoring/duplicate compute.
Regardless of path, config/runtime/hardware mutation creates a new fingerprint generation; never carry a lease or deterministic contract silently across scope mutation.

new_measurement_validity_rules: Treat drift probability during a lease as a lifetime risk ledger distinct from certification alpha, evaluation alpha, and monitor false-alarm budget.
Do not infer D_lease from a degradation monitor's non-alarm. Monitoring controls reaction, not prospective no-change probability.

Match the lease clock to the drift mechanism: request-index hazard for request-triggered changes, calendar/deployment/config-generation hazard for environment mutations. An arbitrary request count is not a valid surrogate.
Statistical leases need both a validity condition (A_cert+A_eval+D_lease) and an economic condition (risk-limited horizon long enough to amortize certification). Passing only one is insufficient.
Verify-before-reveal is qualitatively stronger than monitor-after-reveal: sound per-output equivalence can turn drift into latency/unresolved cost rather than evidence contamination.
Deterministic system claims remain scope-bound. vLLM documents beta/support and same-hardware/version limitations; recent research systems are not universal contracts.
scope_guards: The D_lease theorem is a union-bound decomposition. It does not prove or estimate a real deployment's hazard h; h must come from an explicit prospective assumption or independently justified mechanism.
The hazard table and break-even values are analytic stress calculations, not observed serving drift rates.
The prior K=2276/3700/5679 values come from this worker's earlier stationary Bernoulli admission simulation and only illustrate certification-cost scale.
CoRun and LLM-42 are system-specific research results. Their performance does not establish that every deterministic path is faster than statistical hedging or canonical inference.

A deterministic verifier can set V_verify=0 only if equivalence checking is exact within a frozen verified scope. If the verifier can false-accept, its own lifetime error budget must be accounted for rather than assumed away.

frontier.action: Build the verify-before-reveal firewall for an inexact verifier: derive lifetime V_verify allocation, then stress exact equality, probabilistic equivalence checks, and verifier drift. Compare false-commit risk, rollback rate, wall latency and compute with canonical single-attempt and statistical lease paths.

Optimize A_cert and D_lease allocations jointly across rare/common fingerprints under fixed compute and value weights. Compare simple 1/[j(j+1)] schedules with predictable value-weighted allocations without resetting lifetime risk.

Replace constant per-evaluation hazard with causal clocks: calendar-time/deployment-generation hazard, explicit config invalidation and bounded unobserved drift. Quantify first-post-change exposure separately from probability of any drift.

Stress deterministic-contract scope transitions: hardware/runtime/model/version changes, partial model coverage and verifier implementation faults. Determine when contract verification plus canarying dominates repeated statistical recertification for rare fingerprints.

exact_next_action: Formalize and stress the verify-before-reveal path. The key question is whether a sound per-evaluation equivalence verifier can preserve most hedging latency while replacing the hard-to-justify D_lease term with a smaller, directly auditable V_verify ledger; compare this against canonical and deterministic-by-construction paths under the same frozen fingerprint.
